QF.id: I Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_56

question.text: What is the minimum Price Scan Range (PSR) percentage for USDINR futures under SPAN margining?

explanation.text: The Logic: The PSR table on page 173 lists USDINR at 1.50% (based on 6σ subject to a minimum of 1.50% of underlying price). The Trap: The other listed minimums are EURINR 2.15%, GBPINR 2.25%, JPYINR 2.65%, and EURUSD/GBPUSD/USDJPY 2.50% each — none of which apply to USDINR. Note: The 1.50% figure comes directly from the workbook PSR table; treat it as the anchor value for USDINR futures.
